newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AGA share up on ABZ purchase in Gas Vision.
newsitem.headline: AGA share up on ABZ purchase in Gas Vision.

text.p: Shares in Swedish medical and industrial gas group AGA rose on Monday, spurred by Swiss BZ Group Holding AG's purchasing a stake in Swiss investment group Gas Vision AG, AGA's largest shareholder.
"BZ is now gaining control over Gas Vision and it seems as if this will add further pressure on AGA to return yield to shareholders", a broker said.
At 1330 GMT, AGA was six crowns higher at 112 crowns, while the Stockholm Stock Exchange's general index was up 0.84 percent at 2,796,82.

Gas Vision said earlier on Monday that BZ Gruppe Holding AG had acquired Carba Holding's stake of 500,000 registered shares, giving BZ 100 percent of Gas Vision's registered stock, or 43.5 percent of votes.
A positive newsletter report predicting a strong performance for AGA in 1998 added further strength to the share.
AGA said they did not know whether the purchase meant any changes for the company.
Gas Vision currently has no representation on the board of AGA and the president of AGA, Lennart Selander, has not received any indications that the Swiss company would want any such representation.
